info.title: Collaborative Grid Operations API
info.description: API for synchronizing collaborative grid state using operation-based CRDTs over WebSockets.

baseUrl.description: The base URL of the WebSocket server.

port.description: The port of the WebSocket server.

grid.description: Channel for exchanging CRDT operations for a specific grid session.

gridSessionId.description: The unique identifier for the grid session

replicaId.description: The unique identifier of the subscribing replica.

Authorization.description: Value must be 'Bearer <token>'.  This is the same header required for all authetnicted HTTP requests.

eventsSend.title: Send Events
eventsSend.description: Send live events to all other replicas in the collaboration.

eventsReceive.title: Receive Events
eventsReceive.description: Receive live events from all other replicas in the collaboration. If an event is received out-of-order (event_id > version.replica_id.sequence + 1), it should be ignored, and sychronization should be started. Duplicate events should also be ignored.

sendVersion.title: Send Version
sendVersion.description: Send a replica's version to the hub to start the synchroniziation process. If the hub detects the sender is missing event, then then the missing events will be sent to be sent to: eventSend

receiveVersion.title: Receive Version
receiveVersion.description: Receive the current version of the hub.  If the hub's vesion does not match the replica's version, all missing events that orginate for recipenant should be sent to: eventSend.

GridOperation.summary: Represents a CRDT operation to be applied to the grid state.

replicaId.description: The unique identifier of the replica that generated this operation.

data.description: The data associated with the operation.
